title: Turkish Doner Kebab Tofu Wrap
description: A vegetarian twist on the popular Turkish dish, featuring marinated tofu and fresh orange slices wrapped in a crispy doner kebab.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: Extra-firm, drained and cut into thin strips

instructions: Heat the infused olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tofu and cook for 3-4 minutes, until golden brown and crispy.
Warm the Turkish doner kebab according to package instructions.
Slice the kebab into thin strips.
Assemble the wraps by spreading a layer of tofu on the bottom, followed by a few slices of kebab, lettuce, tomato, onion, cucumber, and orange slices.
Drizzle with additional infused olive oil and sprinkle with paprika.
Optional: add a dollop of tzatziki sauce for extra flavor.
